entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, this is Sarah, how can I help you today?
Yes, hi. I ordered a VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago, and it keeps giving me wildly inaccurate heart rate readings. It’s basically useless! I need to return it.
I understand your frustration with the VeloBand Pulse. I'm happy to help you with a return. We want you to be completely satisfied with your VeloFit purchase.
Well, I certainly am NOT satisfied! What's the return process? How long do I have? This thing is junk.

Our standard policy allows you 90 days for returns. So you have plenty of time to get this sorted out. Don't worry, we'll make this right. Just return it using the prepaid label in your order confirmation email.

Ninety days? Are you sure? Because the website said something about a much shorter window for electronics. I think it was like, 30 days. This is ridiculous! I barely tried it! I need to send it back now.

You are absolutely right, and I apologize for the misinformation. My apologies. The VeloBand Pulse return policy is indeed different from our standard policy for items like apparel. Let me look into this for you directly.
Good, because I was about to lose it. I need this resolved quickly. My training is being affected by this inaccurate data!

I understand. I've checked your order, and I see the purchase date. Since you're within the 30-day window for VeloBand Pulse returns, I can process a return for you right now, and issue you a full refund. I will also email you a prepaid return shipping label, it's the same as the jersey returns so the label and process should look familiar. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account after we receive the device. Does that sound acceptable?
Okay, that sounds much better. So, I just use the label you're going to email me, stick it on the box, and ship it back?

Exactly. The email will also contain instructions on how to package the VeloBand Pulse securely for return shipping. You have plenty of time to do that since you are returning it within the accepted window. No need to rush, but we recommend doing it as soon as you can. Don't worry, you will receive a full refund according to your purchase date.
Okay, great! That's all I needed. Thank you for clearing that up and sorting it out so quickly. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
